messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي كأعداد صحيحة بأرقام 0-9 فقط، بلا فاصلة أو كلمة ملحقة، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"verse":61,"chapter":16,"text":"He formed man, and put a heart in the midst of the body, and gave him breath, life, and understanding,"},{"verse":62,"chapter":16,"text":"yes, the spirit of God Almighty. He who made all things and searches out hidden things in hidden places,"},{"verse":63,"chapter":16,"text":"surely he knows your imagination, and what you think in your hearts. Woe to those who sin, and try to hide their sin!"},{"verse":64,"chapter":16,"text":"Because the Lord will exactly investigate all your works, and he will put you all to shame."},{"verse":65,"chapter":16,"text":"When your sins are brought out before men, you will be ashamed, and your own iniquities will stand as your accusers in that day."}],"book_code":"2ES","chapter":16}

response_format: JSON object with book_code='2ES' and verses array. Each item has chapter, verse, text_ar, review_notes_ar. Return exactly verse numbers 61,62,63,64,65 in this chapter.
